text:
Ethan Ross: Kickoff: we need social + benchmark narrative for the Prompt Templates webinar experiment. Primary ask: a 3-post launch cadence (teaser, playbook highlight, webinar CTA) and a short benchmark one-pager for sales. Experiment: two credit flavors (RSVP-claim 75 vs instant 150). Want routing rules, dashboard events, and a day-7 retention callout.

Maya Li: I'll take social copy + hero image brief. Teaser draft: 'Small prompts, big wins. Watch our live demo -> claim webinar credits.' Playbook post: short stat-led example ("saved 4 hrs on outreach"). CTA post: webinar link + claim-credit CTA.

Connor Blake: For benchmarks, aim to show expected deltas: activation lift, token velocity, and template reuse. I'll produce a one-pager with baseline numbers (orgs using templates now) and a conservative uplift projection for sales to reference.

Rina Das: Routing: add exp param on signup links. Pseudo: 

```
// incoming signup
const cohort = req.query.exp || 'open_credit';
crm.addTag(userId, `exp:${cohort}`);
if (cohort === 'rsvp_claim') routeTo('ae_queue', {priority: 'high'});
else routeTo('growth_inbound');
```

Also add a webhook to push cohort into CRM.

DeployBot: Experiment registered: exp_id=pt_launch_20240513; dashboard: https://growth.internal/exp/pt_launch_20240513. Alerts: budget cap 250k tokens/arm.

Ethan Ross: Good. For onboarding nudges, let's A/B test two flows: "quick open" vs "guided playbook". Quick open: single button to templates. Guided: modal with 2-step flow and example filled in. Metrics: template_opened, template_applied, demo_sent.

Maya Li: Social timing: Teaser 2 days before, playbook 1 day before, CTA morning of. We'll adapt creatives for LinkedIn and Twitter. I'll upload assets to the shared folder.

Connor Blake: One-pager to sales will include a 30s script: "Use credits to try a template; if they hit X tokens/day, ask about Dedicated." Also include competitor notes.

Rina Das: Pushing routing to staging now. Will share runbook and test checklist.

Ethan Ross: Target launch date Mon 2024-05-13. Reporting cadence: daily cohort counts + snapshots at day3/day7 + post-mortem. Thanks team — post links here when ready. :rocket:
